title: NEW Puffco Peak WAX/OIL Smart Rig Vaporizer (taxes extra)
description:
The NEW Puffco Peak

The New Peak is the most effortless dab experience ever. Smarter, simpler, and comfy in hand, the original intelligent vaporizer now features a 3D Chamber, Joystick Cap, and real-time temperature control. With its seamless single-button interface, premium water filtration and four dialed heat presets, the Peak makes enjoying hash easy — every time.

If you are looking for a smart mid-tier E Rig that provides high-quality vapor, look no further. The New Peak uses USB-C and can last for up to 35 Dabs per charge. It’s a great option for anyone who wants a small upgrade from Wax Pens, especially considering the Peak uses water filtration as with any E Rig.

The New Peak will satisfy users who want a quick and easy way of getting high-quality vapor without extra complicated steps or apps.

Product Features:
– Hand-blown borosilicate glass
– 3D chamber
– Joystick cap
– Water filtration or dry dabs
– Four heat settings
– Real-time temperature control
– Up to 35 dabs per charge
– Battery life LED

What’s Included:
1 x Peak Base
1 x Peak Glass 2.0
1 x Peak 3D Chamber
1 x Peak Joystick Cap
1 x USB-C Cable
1 x Loading Tool
4 x Cotton Swabs
1 x Quick Start Guide

Warranty
For any device or troubleshooting issues, please email support@puffco.com
